name: TextPressure-TS-TW
title: Text Pressure
blurb: Variable font characteristics (weight, width, italic, opacity) respond to…
description: Renders text where each character modulates its font-variation-settings based on distance to the cursor. Supports weight, width, italic, and alpha adjustments. Requires a variable font supporting these axes.
use_when: An interactive heading wants to showcase a variable font's responsiveness and depth.
avoid_when: On touch devices without hover capability or when using fonts without variable axes.
a11y: Text is rendered as characters in spans; readable but font adjustments may impact legibility temporarily.
